# Design P0-2 v1 (user-locked)
## Goal
TRT H2D/D2H pinned staging slots must not be pool-released while the session stream may still touch them on error returns.
## Bounds
No packing/Docker. TensorRT path only.
## Root cause
StagingSlotGuard.abandon never set; D2HSlotGuard had no abandon; cudaFreeHost-without-sync also unsafe.
## Fix
Both guards hold cudaStream_t; abandon => sync-then-release to pool. Error returns set abandon before matching successful sync.

# Design P1-5 v1 (user-locked)
## Goal
SuperPoint keypoint sort uses a strict weak ordering.
## Bounds
One-line comparator; no score-threshold semantics change.
## Root cause
`return pt1.score >= pt2.score` is reflexive → UB for std::sort.
## Fix
Use `>` (descending by score).

4. Occupancy: document optional measured RSS residual — add comment in occupancy_gate that process RSS is out-of-band via pack_occupancy measured-json (already has measured_gpu_mem); no fake RSS sampler.
